heading: INT. GENERATION SHIP HELIOS-9 - SEED VAULT DECK - SHIP NIGHT

units.text: INT. GENERATION SHIP HELIOS-9 - SEED VAULT DECK - SHIP NIGHT
A low arched chamber lined with frosted drawers of seed.
Pale green grow lights hum.
Condensation beads on steel.
TEODORA VASK, 50s, a quiet botanist in a faded gray jumpsuit, walks the aisle with a tablet, touching each drawer as she passes.
Barley, two hundred and eleven. Barley, two hundred and twelve. You're all still here. Good.
units.name: TEODORA

units.text: She stops at a drawer that is slightly open, closes it with a click, and makes a note.
Humidity at point four. Slightly high. Always slightly high.
units.name: TEODORA

units.text: The hatch hisses.
IMANI QUILL, 20s, in the white sash of a ship's archivist, steps in with a stack of data slates against her chest.
She looks lost.
Is this the vault? They said Deck Nine, but all the doors say Deck Nine.
units.name: IMANI

units.text: It's the vault. You're the new archivist.
units.name: TEODORA

units.text: I'm Imani. I'm sorry, I didn't know anyone would be here at this hour.
units.name: IMANI

units.text: Nobody is, ever. That's why I come.
units.name: TEODORA

units.text: Imani lays her slates on a workbench and glances at the drawers.
How many seeds are in here?
units.name: IMANI

units.text: Eleven million, give or take. She says that, the ship, in her reports. I say it feels like more when you count them by hand.
units.name: TEODORA

units.text: She doesn't mean the ship. She means the Registrar, the one who wrote the index.
units.name: IMANI

units.text: Ah. Then she's wrong, too. She never came down here.
units.name: TEODORA

units.text: They share a small, tired smile.
Teodora hands Imani a spare tablet.
Start at drawer one. Read me the label on each, slowly.
units.name: TEODORA

units.text: Just read?
units.name: IMANI

units.text: Just read. I listen better than I count.
units.name: TEODORA

units.text: Imani sits on the stool, props the tablet on her knee, and reads aloud.
Wheat, hard red winter. Wheat, soft white. Rye.
units.name: IMANI

units.text: Teodora closes her eyes and listens.
